Answer: A
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a cystic lung lesion with a visible systemic feeding vessel on color Doppler (Figure 2), which is the hallmark radiological sign of pulmonary sequestration. While the option mentions a chest X-ray, the provided figures are ultrasounds confirming the vascular nature of the anomaly, distinguishing it from CCAM/CPAM which typically lacks a systemic arterial supply.
